name: harness-engineering-toolkit
description: Diagnose and fix the harness around your AI agent — the system that decides whether it succeeds or fails.
author: nnabuuu

skills.name: harness-self-check
skills.description: Interactive diagnostic. Probes five blind spots in your AI agent harness through conversation.

skills.name: harness-audit
skills.description: Automated codebase scan. Detects five blind spots by checking files, CI config, and git history. Offers auto-fix.

skills.name: harness-create
skills.description: End-to-end harness creation: interview, spec, runnable project. Three build modes: document, code, investigation.

skills.name: harness-retro
skills.description: Retrospective on completed harness tasks. Analyzes convergence, bottlenecks, cost. Suggests improvements. Standalone archive mode for quick workspace cleanup.
